description:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Salesforce Business Analyst to help build and scale our CRM, reporting, and analytics capabilities, as part of our Revenue Operations team.

Why it matters: This role owns and administers our Salesforce Media Cloud instance, ensuring the platform supports the needs of our revenue organization and serves as a trusted source of data. Beyond day-to-day Salesforce administration, this role will develop reporting, analytics, and insights that turn revenue data into meaningful business intelligence. This role will report to the Senior Director of Revenue Strategy and Operations. 

Go deeper: This is an opportunity for someone early in their Salesforce and Revenue Operations career who wants hands-on ownership while expanding their skills across systems, processes, and analytics. You’ll partner closely with Revenue Enablement, Client Partnerships, Client Experience, and Business Development teams to solve business challenges, improve revenue processes, and help teams use Salesforce and data more effectively. Responsibilities include:

  • Serve as the day-to-day administrator for Salesforce Media Cloud, managing users, permissions, page layouts, flows, reports, dashboards, validation rules, and automation.
  • Partner with Revenue Strategy & Enablement, Revenue Operations, and sales leadership to translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions and operational improvements.
  • Build and optimize a Salesforce environment that supports Axios’ evolving revenue organization, sales processes, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and recurring analyses that give executives, sales leadership, and cross-functional partners actionable visibility into business performance, sales metrics, and KPIs.
  • Support data migration and ongoing data management efforts, ensuring data quality, integrity, consistency, and governance across Salesforce.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows, streamline processes, and improve operational efficiency across the revenue organization.
  • Support sales planning and performance management, including sales goals, conversion and segment analysis, Quarterly Business Reviews, and weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting.
  • Troubleshoot user and system issues, recommend scalable solutions, and support testing, deployment, and change management for Salesforce releases and enhancements.
  • Create and maintain documentation, best practices, and training materials while supporting user adoption of Salesforce functionality, reporting tools, and revenue processes.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, have a passion for the Axios mission, and the following skills and experience:

  • 1–2 years of Salesforce Administrator experience.
  • 1–2 years of experience in sales operations or sales analytics.
  • Salesforce Administrator Certification (ADM-201) or plans to obtain certification within the first year.
  • Experience helping build or significantly expand a Salesforce organization from the ground up, or participating in a major Salesforce implementation.
  • Experience building flows, reports, dashboards, validation rules, and custom objects.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, profiles, permission sets, and data management best practices.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and a customer-service mindset when supporting end users.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and improve business processes.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with Salesforce Media Cloud.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with third-party applications.
  • Experience supporting a Salesforce data migration from one CRM or Salesforce org to another.
  • Experience working in the media industry.

Within your first year, you'll help establish a scalable Salesforce foundation that supports Axios' revenue organization by:

  • Delivering a stable, well-governed Salesforce environment that users trust.
  • Successfully supporting the migration from our legacy CRM while maintaining data quality.
  • Improving automation and reducing manual administrative work across revenue teams.
  • Increasing Salesforce adoption through thoughtful training, documentation, and user support.
  • Partnering with cross-functional teams to improve how they leverage data and analytics to understand their business.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $65,000 - $75,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

What Axios brings to the table besides salary:

  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Robust PPO and High Deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network
  • Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high deductible health plan option
  • Dental and vision coverage
  • Primary caregiver 12-week paid leave
  • Birth-givers will have an additional 6-8 weeks depending on type of delivery, for a total of 18-20 weeks continuous leave
  • Generous vacation policy, plus holidays
  • One mental health day per quarter
  • Annual learning and development stipend
  • $100 monthly work-from-home stipend
  • Tele-mental health services through Headspace
  • OneMedical membership, including tele-health services
  • Personal health advocacy resources through HealthAdvocate
  • Inclusive fertility, hormonal health and family forming benefits through Carrot Fertility
  • Access to the Axios “Family Fund”, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies
  • Increased work flexibility for parents and caretakers
  • Virtual company-sponsored social events
  • A strong and positive work environment
  • A commitment to an open, inclusive, and diverse work culture

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

Axios is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Axios makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.
